activeTasks.title: install through a capacity-aware candidate
activeTasks.objective: Preflight required working space, install into an owned candidate, validate it, and atomically activate without losing the last known-good install.
acceptance: Insufficient space is rejected before mutation; a validated candidate becomes formal while a failed candidate preserves the prior install.
invariants: Avoid retaining duplicate full installations after commit.
